drafted_from: tool:code-the-comments-that-name-a-character's row in tools/measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging/tool-rows.json, its script in tools/measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging/do-work/ and the tests in tools/measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging/test/
start_here: Say to your AI: "Code the comments that name the parrot with my codebook, pleasure and absence." It runs tool:code-the-comments-that-name-a-character on comments-character.tsv.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it reads one settings row of yours (record:setting:measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging~<scope_kind>~<scope_id>) or the settings you pass, and works on files in the show's folder.
instructions: 1. Make the show's folder and the YouTube library folder the run may change, and have comments-character.tsv from tool:collect-the-comments-that-name-a-character. Put the keys the row needs (codebook) in your settings row or pass them as settings.

2. Say the sentence in start_here to your AI. It calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:code-the-comments-that-name-a-character and the input in the worked example; the door asks for the granted folder.
3. Read the last line it prints, {"result": ...}, or {"error": ...} saying what to fix (a missing settings key is named).
4. Read comments-character-coded.tsv: a comment gets every code it matches, and a comment that matches none is coded mention-only.

worked_examples.title: Three comments coded
worked_examples.given: From the sample run in tools/measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging/tool-rows.json: comments-character.tsv holds c1 "The parrot is so funny" (9 likes), c3 "I missed the parrot" (3 likes) and c5 "Polly!" (0 likes); codebook pleasure = "funny|laugh", absence = "miss(ed)? (him|the parrot)".
worked_examples.hands_back: {"result": {"table": "{grant:change-a-folder}/show/comments-character-coded.tsv", "comments": 3, "codes": {"pleasure": 1, "absence": 1, "mention-only": 1}}}; coded rows: c1 pleasure, c3 absence, c5 mention-only.
